steps.instructions: Inside the assigned output directory, make a disposable clone of {{cwd}} named work and check out {{base:sh}} there. Work only in that clone. {{prompt}} When finished, from the root of work run `git add -A -- . && git diff --cached --binary --full-index --no-ext-diff --no-textconv {{base:sh}} -- . > ../changes.diff`. Force-add any intended ignored deliverable before this step. After the patch succeeds, remove only the disposable clone. Your final answer must answer the original request, even when no files changed. The runtime saves it as response.md. Do not write that file yourself.
